<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><b>Item 8.01. Other
Events.</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">Effective as of October
2, 2026, BILI Social International, Inc. (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) terminated Equiniti Trust Company LLC as its transfer agent and appointed
VStock Transfer, LLC (&#8220;VStock&#8221;) as the Company&#8217;s transfer agent and registrar for its securities. All of the Company&#8217;s
shareholder records have been transferred to VStock. VStock is located at 18 Lafayette Place, Woodmere, NY 11598; and telephone (212)
828-8436.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>
